name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV: Yami ni Sasayaku Kyouki
original_name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV 闇に囁く狂気
source:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of the Cthulhu Mythos with this 2D visual novel game featuring a thrilling TRPG-based experience! Roll the dice and use your skills and luck to escape the abandoned hospital, while experiencing the cosmic terror.

You find yourself in an odd abandoned hospital, with memories clouded.
Strange voices echo through your mind…
In this place where unsettling things happen, you must maintain your sanity while uncovering the truth.

The only things you can rely on are “Ability” and “Luck”.

You also might need some “helping hand”, occasionally…

Will you and your friends be able to escape the cycle?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965920/Cthulhu_Mythos_ADV_Lunatic_Whispers/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
玩这款2D视觉小说游戏，体验激动人心的TRPG体验，让自己沉浸在克苏鲁神话的迷人世界中！掷骰子，利用你的技能和运气逃离废弃医院，同时体验宇宙恐怖。

你发现自己身处一家奇怪的废弃医院，记忆被蒙蔽。
奇怪的声音在你的脑海中回响……
在这个令人不安的事情发生的地方，你必须保持理智，同时揭开真相。

唯一可以依靠的就是“能力”和“运气”。

有时你可能还需要一些“帮助”……

你和你的朋友能摆脱这个循环吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965920/Cthulhu_Mythos_ADV_Lunatic_Whispers/]Steam[/url]]
